'''Larris Cozekk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he and his men attempted to clean the reactor out, but were ambushed by irradiated [[Rakghoul]]s.<ref name="Mutations" /> Being the only survivor, he sent a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to head into the abandoned reactor in the [[Tularan Marsh]] and defeat the Rakghouls.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
